stories.title: SonicWall NetExtender Vulnerabilities Allow an Attacker to Write Arbitrary Files as Root
stories.description: SonicWall has disclosed two security vulnerabilities in its NetExtender Linux client, including a critical path traversal flaw that could allow an attacker to write arbitrary files with root privileges.

stories.description: Most of the flaws were discovered by Google using AI, but researchers are still discovering high-value Chrome vulnerabilities.

stories.description: TranslatePress WordPress plugin flaw lets unauthenticated attackers hijack admin accounts and compromise websites.

stories.title: Iran-Linked Hackers Abuse Legitimate Developer Tool to Hide Dindoor Backdoor
stories.description: Iran-linked MuddyWater uses Deno to hide Dindoor backdoor activity, targeting U.S. software, banking, and Canadian organizations.

stories.title: INTERPOL Operation Jackal IV Arrests 58, Identifies 263 in Global Cyber Fraud Crackdown
stories.description: INTERPOL's Operation Jackal IV arrests 58 people, identifies 263 suspects, and disrupts fraud and laundering networks across 22 countries.

stories.title: Sensitive Information Exposed in Nutex Health Data Breach

stories.title: Newly SLEEPWALKER Backdoor Waits for One Crafted Packet, Then Runs Its Own Bytecode
stories.description: SLEEPWALKER is a Windows backdoor that waits for a crafted packet, then runs 23-instruction bytecode across six transports.
